practice.q1why: "Look forward to" is followed by the -ing form.
practice.q2why: "Exhausted" is a stronger way to say very tired.
practice.q3b: me up from the station at six?
practice.q3why: "Pick someone up" means to collect them.
practice.q4why: Use the present perfect with "since" for something still true.
practice.q5: Your friend says "Thanks so much!" The most natural reply is…
practice.q5why: "No worries!" is a friendly, natural reply.
practice.q6why: A stingy person does not like to share.
practice.q7: Which word has a silent letter?
practice.q8b: more time, I would travel more.
practice.q8why: The second conditional uses the past simple after "if".
practice.q9why: It means making people feel relaxed at first.
practice.q10why: The stress falls on the second syllable: pho-TOG-ra-pher.
